method.execution: lines executed by the run's kept tests inside the unit's own span (aggregate coverage)
method.next: per-test coverage contexts, private callees, sampling stratified over the reached units
method.strength: mutants sampled inside the unit's own span and killed by a kept test

reasons.did-not-build: every candidate for this behaviour failed to compile or collect
reasons.executed-not-checked: lines ran, no mutant inside them was killed
reasons.failed-on-head: the tests for this behaviour are wrong
reasons.flaky: the only tests for this behaviour disagreed with themselves
reasons.no-test-generated: no kept test names or executes this behaviour
reasons.not-in-public-api: the application references a name the package's public API does not define
reasons.out-of-budget: beyond this run's budget; recorded so it is not forgotten
reasons.pipeline-cannot-validate: the repository's CI cannot run or validate the proposed tests
reasons.strength-not-sampled: lines ran, no mutant was placed inside them; a sampling gap the harness owns

unit: a behaviour the change reaches: a public function, method or type of the package the application calls, or a public symbol the change altered
